name: Nikolaos Makriyannis
biography: Nikolaos Makriyannis (Nikos), Cryptography Research Lead at Fireblocks, is a cryptography PhD, specializing in the areas of multiparty computation (MPC). Nikos is the co-inventor of the CMP20 and CGGMP21 protocols published in ACM CCS'20 and used by multiple wallet providers.
